info.title: UM-B4 Center Management API
info.description: Isolated, loopback-only B4 admin-plane API on the admin listener. Ingest /v1/agent/* is never served here. Authentication is a local operator-owned bearer-token file; roles and event scopes are resolved server-side. UM-C Web UI/login/TOTP/session/Cloudflare and public ingress are not implemented.
